# Perlette Cakes

Perlette Cakes is a home-based baker in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, delivering to Klang, Selangor.

The public website is being developed to include a menu-based order-request flow. Customers can currently send order details or questions to Perlette Cakes on WhatsApp.

## Business Summary

- Products: custom celebration cakes, cupcakes, pastries, and cookies
- Delivery: to approved addresses in Klang, Selangor via Lalamove
- Pickup: not offered
- Lead time: usually 3 to 5 days, with more notice needed for larger or more detailed orders
- Ordering: menu-based order requests are in development; order details can currently be sent on WhatsApp
- WhatsApp: +60 19-650 5050
